description: Search the UK statute book on legislation.gov.uk by full text or title, or list legislation by type and year, filtered by geographical extent and point in time. Full-text search ranks by relevance; title searches and type/year listings run newest year first and carry type and year counts (facets) to narrow with. Each result gives the item path to pass to uklaw_get_document. For a known citation or short title, uklaw_lookup_citation is cheaper and exact.

as_of.description: Point in time YYYY-MM-DD: only legislation as it stood on that date (items not yet enacted or made are excluded). Omit for current law. Cannot combine with extent.

extent.description: Geographical extent: england, wales, scotland, ni. An item matches when one of its provisions extends there. Cannot combine with as_of. legislation.gov.uk has not recorded provision-level extent for many recent items, so an empty result does not prove nothing extends there.

extent_match.description: Used only with extent. applicable: a provision extends to any given extent; exact: a provision extends to exactly that set.

text.description: Full-text query. Supports AND/OR, "quoted phrases", and stemming. Omit for a title search or a listing.

title.description: Words that must all occur in the title. For a known short title or citation, uklaw_lookup_citation is exact.

types.description: Type codes (ukpga, uksi, asp, eur, …) and/or groups (all, primary, secondary, eu-origin, draft). "all" covers UK and EU-origin legislation, excluding drafts, and absorbs any other value. uklaw_list_reference topic types lists the codes.

year.description: Calendar year (also for pre-1963 Acts numbered by regnal year). Not combinable with year_from/year_to.

year_from.description: Earliest calendar year of a range; the other bound may be omitted.

year_to.description: Latest calendar year of a range; the other bound may be omitted.

name: uklaw_search_legislation

attribution.description: Attribution lines the returned content requires (OGL always; EU and Westlaw credits when applicable).

cap.description: Page size that capped the list.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date`: as_of is shaped YYYY-MM-DD but is not a real calendar date. `extent_with_as_of`: Both extent and as_of are set. `invalid_year_range`: year is combined with a range, or year_from is after year_to. `filter_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered the search feed with 404 or 400: a filter combination it does not accept. `upstream_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered 403 or 429 (its fair use rate limit or a block). `pacer_shed`: The shared request queue cannot start this call within its deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Type and year counts — title searches and listings only; absent on full-text searches and on a page past the last page.

years.description: Matching items per year, newest 25 years; a year filter is left out of these counts so neighbouring years show.

years_omitted.description: Further years with matches beyond the 25 listed.

has_more.description: True when a further page exists (call again with page + 1).

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, or how to fetch the next page.

alternative_numbers.description: Alternative series numbers, e.g. W. 89 for a Welsh SI; empty when none.

series.description: Series letter: W. (Wales), C. (commencement), S. (Scotland), L. (legal), NI.

document_uri.description: Version-specific document URI legislation.gov.uk links for the entry; absent when none is linked.

item.description: Item path to pass to uklaw_get_document, e.g. ukpga/2018/12.

made_date.description: Date enacted or made (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when not reported.

number.description: Number within the year (an ISBN for drafts).

subjects.description: Subject headings legislation.gov.uk assigns; empty when none.

summary.description: Summary or long title; absent when legislation.gov.uk gives none.

updated.description: When legislation.gov.uk last updated the item; absent when not reported.

year.description: Calendar year; absent when legislation.gov.uk does not report it.

as_of.description: Point in time searched: "current" or a date.

extent.description: Extents filtered on; present only when extent was given.

extent_match.description: Extent matching applied; present only when extent was given.

total.description: Total matches; present only when legislation.gov.uk reports it (often absent on large result sets).

truncated.description: True when more results exist beyond this page.

title: Search UK legislation
